messages:
maya: Quick sync — privacy squad approved the offboarding appendix. Need to finalize manager checklist, opt-in copy, and a super-short microtraining.

trent: Nice. Short policy bullets: delete personal account data within 30 days unless legal hold; backups/logs kept up to 12 months for investigations; device images removed unless employee opts in with manager signoff.

anya: Can we add a single checkbox on the e-sign offboard form? Wording suggestion: "I allow temporary retention of logs/backups for security review (up to 12 months)."

olivia: Ops note: our export will snapshot fields before deprovisioning. Suggested CSV columns: employee_id,name,email,manager,last_login,primary_repo_access,device_serial. We'll run export 24h prior.

maya: Training: record an ~8 min video for managers covering the checklist and consent flow. Managers must acknowledge (1-click) within 7 days of any exit. Tracking sheet columns: manager, employee_id, opt_in(Y/N), training_ack(Y/N), ack_ts.

trent: CLI snippet for infra:
```
# offboard snapshot for uid 5567
redwood-admin export --user 5567 --fields employee_id,name,email,manager,last_login,primary_repo_access,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-5567.csv
```

anya: I'll draft the handbook paragraph and an FAQ entry clarifying when retention windows start (termination date).

hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish appendix to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager recording for 2026-05-10 11:00 PT.

olivia: Please confirm retention clock starts at termination date, not deprovision. Ops relies on that for snapshots.

maya: Confirmed — retention starts at termination date. I'll post the draft + the manager slide and tracker link in #people-ops-docs for review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
